review: Update: hammering everyone with Red Bull drinks ads that you have to close before getting a code sucks. The rewards program is fine. The app is too persistent. When I swipe the app to close it, I want it to close and stop running. I do not want this app running all the time collecting data. I get that "I'm the product", but I'm already giving McDs money. So stop siphoning data.

It seems like every 6-9 months my account gets nuked and I have to recover it, only to find my 40k+ points are gone and have to start over again. Just waiting for the next update that will incorporate ads on top of the 4 clicks of add-ons just to order a meal.
